es.tagline: Mide tu carga laboral. Explora qué podría cambiar.

landing.headline: Entiende cuánto agotamiento laboral estás acumulando ahora.
landing.body: Responde 7 preguntas del Copenhagen Burnout Inventory. Obtendrás un score actual de 0–100, una referencia contextual y un informe con escenarios condicionales. No es un diagnóstico ni una predicción.
landing.trust: Cálculo auditable · 7 ítems CBI · Sin biometría · Sin datos personales antes del informe

country.title: ¿Dónde trabajas principalmente?
country.help: Solo ajusta idioma, moneda y notas de evidencia. No cambia tu score.

questions.emotionally_exhausting: ¿En qué grado tu trabajo resulta emocionalmente agotador?
questions.burned_out_due_work: ¿En qué grado te sientes quemado/a a causa del trabajo?
questions.work_frustrates: ¿En qué grado tu trabajo te frustra?
questions.worn_out_end_day: ¿Con qué frecuencia terminas agotado/a al final de la jornada?
questions.exhausted_morning: ¿Con qué frecuencia amaneces agotado/a al pensar en otro día de trabajo?
questions.every_working_hour_tiring: ¿Con qué frecuencia sientes que cada hora de trabajo es agotadora?
questions.energy_family_friends: ¿Con qué frecuencia tienes suficiente energía para familia y amigos durante el tiempo libre?

assessment.privacy: Tus respuestas no se envían a analítica de terceros.

processing.title: Calculando tu score
processing.note: El cálculo es determinista; no usamos IA generativa para producir la cifra.

preview.above: Tu score está en o por encima del umbral de referencia PUMA de 50.
preview.below: Tu score está por debajo del umbral de referencia PUMA de 50.
preview.context: PUMA: trabajadores de servicios humanos en Dinamarca. Referencia contextual, no norma global ni diagnóstico.
preview.action_body: Elige un cambio pequeño y observable relacionado con tu driver principal y repite el chequeo después; no interpretes una sola medición como destino.
preview.locked_title: Qué podría cambiar si cambian tus respuestas
preview.locked_body: El informe muestra escenarios condicionales de mejora / sin cambio / empeora. Son what-if matemáticos, no predicciones.

request.consent: Acepto usar mi email para generar y entregar este informe.
request.marketing: Quiero recibir novedades de StressCast. Opcional.

request.consent_required: Necesitamos tu consentimiento de entrega para enviarte el informe.

success.title: Informe preparado
success.body: En producción, recibirías un enlace privado por email. En este prototipo puedes abrirlo aquí.

report.title: Tu informe StressCast
report.scenario_note: Si hasta dos drivers cambian una categoría. No representa probabilidad, pronóstico ni intervalo de confianza.

legal.disclaimer: StressCast es una herramienta de reflexión sobre bienestar laboral. No diagnostica, trata ni sustituye a un profesional cualificado. No debe usarse para tomar decisiones laborales sobre otra persona.

en.tagline: Measure your work burnout. Explore what could change.

landing.headline: See how much work-related exhaustion you are carrying right now.
landing.body: Answer 7 Copenhagen Burnout Inventory questions. You’ll get a current 0–100 score, contextual reference and a report with conditional scenarios. It is not a diagnosis or a prediction.
landing.trust: Auditable calculation · 7 CBI items · No biometrics · No personal data before the report

country.title: Where do you mainly work?
country.help: This only adjusts language, currency and evidence notes. It does not change your score.

questions.emotionally_exhausting: To what degree is your work emotionally exhausting?
questions.burned_out_due_work: To what degree do you feel burned out because of your work?
questions.work_frustrates: To what degree does your work frustrate you?
questions.worn_out_end_day: How often do you feel worn out at the end of the working day?
questions.exhausted_morning: How often are you exhausted in the morning at the thought of another day at work?
questions.every_working_hour_tiring: How often do you feel that every working hour is tiring for you?
questions.energy_family_friends: How often do you have enough energy for family and friends during leisure time?

assessment.privacy: Your answers are not sent to third-party analytics.

processing.title: Calculating your score
processing.note: The calculation is deterministic; generative AI does not produce the number.

preview.above: Your score is at or above the PUMA reference threshold of 50.
preview.below: Your score is below the PUMA reference threshold of 50.
preview.context: PUMA: human-service workers in Denmark. Contextual reference, not a global norm or diagnosis.
preview.action_body: Choose one small, observable change related to your top driver and re-check later; do not treat a single measurement as destiny.
preview.locked_title: What could change if your responses change
preview.locked_body: The report shows conditional improve / no-change / worsen scenarios. They are mathematical what-ifs, not predictions.

request.title: Get the full report free
request.body: We’ll send your what-if scenarios, top 3 drivers, contextual benchmark, 7-day plan and methodology.
request.consent: I agree to use my email to generate and deliver this report.
request.privacy: During validation, a copy of your responses, result and PDF is sent to the StressCast operator to review and complete manual delivery. It is not used for employment decisions or third-party analytics.
request.consent_required: We need delivery consent to send your report.

success.title: Report ready
success.body: In production, you would receive a private link by email. In this prototype, you can open it here.

report.title: Your StressCast report
report.scenario_note: If up to two drivers move one category. This is not a probability, forecast or confidence interval.

legal.disclaimer: StressCast is a work-wellbeing reflection tool. It does not diagnose, treat or replace a qualified professional. It must not be used to make employment decisions about another person.
legal.support: If distress is severe, persistent or affects safety or daily functioning, seek appropriate professional support in your country.

pt.tagline: Meça seu esgotamento no trabalho. Explore o que pode mudar.

landing.trust: Cálculo auditável · 7 itens CBI · Sem biometria · Sem dados pessoais antes do relatório

country.title: Onde você trabalha principalmente?
